The '''1125 Heads-Up Macrobinoculars''' were a model of [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]] widely used by the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]]. Made handsfree, the 1125 was designed to be strapped to the head, and was capable of offering information on range, azimuth, and elevation. It also had a light-enhancing feature, which was capable of automatically enhancing twilight or night time conditions to seem like daylight. The 1125 was also capable of a a maximum zoom of 1,000 meters.<ref name="ROE" />
